title: Hearty Roasted Ethiopian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring roasted lamb, vine leaves, and ferment-kimchi, made in a ceramic tagine, perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe is whole30-friendly and serves 6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine lamb, onion, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Stuff each vine leaf with the lamb mixture and roll into a neat package.
In a ceramic tagine, combine the rolled vine leaves, ferment-kimchi, and melted coconut oil.
Cover the tagine with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the vine leaves are crispy.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of roasted vegetables.
